scope: All ordinary body-flow citations, their exact nearby claims, primary publication records and supporting passages, canonical BibTeX metadata, closest-prior-result comparison, user-library relevance, bibliography coverage, and final AUX/log consistency were checked. Mathematical certificate correctness remains governed by the accepted frozen math audit.
citation_audit_method: Two-stage citation-check protocol: freeze the complete claim/key ledger, then independently run per-record title, author/year/venue, DOI or arXiv searches and inspect exact primary-source theorem, section, page, or HTML-line passages; finish with canonical BibTeX/AUX/log checks.
